name: market_pipeline_health_analysis
description: Procedure for evaluating transaction success performance at the market level and identifying potential pipeline-related causes.
procedure_steps: Aggregate roster processing data by CNT_STATE
Calculate counts of stuck and failed roster operations for each state
Merge aggregated pipeline metrics with the market operational dataset
Evaluate market SCS_PERCENT values against pipeline issue indicators
Highlight markets where reduced success rates align with pipeline disruptions
expected_outputs: List of states showing declining operational success rates
Insights linking pipeline processing delays with transaction failures
application_context: Operational analytics teams run this workflow to understand whether market performance degradation is associated with upstream pipeline processing issues.
